title: Global Learning Operations & Governance Manager
searchText: Global Learning Operations & Governance Manager  Databricks CSQ126R20 Role summary: The Global Operations & Governance Manager is a senior, enterprise-level leader responsible for architecting the AI-enabled operating system that powers ENGAGE (aka Training Operations Team) globally. This role establishes and leads the Global Center of Excellence (CoE), designing a scalable hub-and-spoke model that transforms regional execution into predictable, revenue-aligned, and financially disciplined outcomes. This is a enterprise transformation role. You will embed automation, analytics, governance, and commercial rigor into the core of Learning & Enablement (L&E) operations, ensuring ENGAGE scales with consistency, control, and confidence. Why This Role Matters: This is a transformation year for Learning & Enablement (L&E). As learner demand, partners, SKUs, and regions scale, traditional operating models no longer hold. Success requires predictive visibility, automation-first execution, and globally consistent governed operations , not incremental process improvement. This role enables ENGAGE to operate with repeatable economics, convert operational gains into measurable capacity and revenue impact, reduce reliance on manual intervention, and scale with discipline. Key Responsibilities: Global Operating Model & CoE Leadership Establish and lead the Global Center of Excellence as the owner of operating standards, governance, tooling, and analytics. Design and operationalize a hub-and-spoke model that balances global consistency with strong regional execution. Standardize planning cadences, decision rights, playbooks, and forecasting frameworks. Embed accountability and performance rigor into QBRs, MBRs, and global reviews. AI-Enabled Operations & Telemetry Enhance and lead ENGAGE’s AI-first operating roadmap. Operationalize real-time KPIs, dashboards, and predictive exception signals to surface demand, capacity, and risk. Institutionalize intelligent intake, agentic workflows, and automation across scheduling, forecasting, certification, and partner management. Establish governance principles for AI and automation, ensuring reliability, transparency, and measurable business impact. Commercial Strategy & Revenue Discipline Define and institutionalize best in class revenue practices, including SKU governance, forecasting discipline, revenue recognition guardrails, and margin optimization. Translate operational gains into measurable commercial impact (capacity unlock, improved utilization, fill-rate gains, partner spend reduction). Partner with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Commercialization to ensure executive-grade reporting and P&L transparency. Embed financial controls aligned with audit readiness and long-term scalability. Enterprise Governance & Risk Management Build a globally consistent environment across planning, reporting, exception management, and automation oversight. Ensure audit resilience, compliance readiness, and structured risk mitigation across regions. Establish clear decision rights and ownership models to eliminate ambiguity and friction. Change Leadership & Global Oversight Lead global adoption of standardized processes, AI-enabled workflows, and governance frameworks. Define and elevate operational maturity benchmarks across regions. Act as a strategic advisor to L&E and Strat-Ops leadership on scale, risk, and operating evolution. Influence without authority across distributed, matrixed teams to embed discipline and alignment. What Success Looks Like: Building a predictable, standardized global operating model with clear decision rights and executive-ready reporting. Real-time, predictive visibility into global demand, capacity, performance, and exceptions. Demonstrable conversion of operational improvements into capacity unlocks, reduced partner spend, and revenue uplift. Automation and AI embedded into daily operations, materially reducing manual overhead and cycle times. High regional adoption of CoE standards and tooling. Required Qualifications: 10+ years in GTM Operations, Revenue Operations, or Program Leadership within global high-growth technology companies. Proven experience building and scaling enterprise operating models and governance programs. Demonstrated success leading automation, analytics, or AI-driven transformation initiatives with measurable impact. Deep commercial fluency, including forecasting, revenue operations, utilization economics, and P&L drivers. Strong partnership experience with Finance, Legal, Strategy, and Revenue leadership. Exceptional analytical rigor and executive-level communication skills. Preferred Qualifications: Exposure to audit processes, SOX readiness, or public-company financial controls. Familiarity with SaaS, data, AI, or cloud business models. Experience leading global change management initiatives. Hands-on experience with analytics platforms or Databricks products. Demonstrated success embedding AI into operational workflows at scale. Why Join Us: You will architect the global operating system that enables ENGAGE to scale with speed, discipline, and financial rigor. This is a high-visibility role with enterprise impact—shaping how Learning & Enablement operates in an AI-first world. If you’re energized by building systems that convert complexity into predictable performance, and by embedding governance without sacrificing agility, this role offers the opportunity to leave a lasting operational legacy. Pay Range Transparency Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected base salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipated utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. For more information regarding which range your location is in visit our page here . Zone 1 Pay Range $148,600 — $204,250 USD Zone 2 Pay Range $133,700 — $183,800 USD Zone 3 Pay Range $126,200 — $173,600 USD Zone 4 Pay Range $118,900 — $163,450 USD About Databricks Databricks is the data and AI company. More than 10,000 organizations worldwide — including Comcast, Condé Nast, Grammarly, and over 50% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to unify and democratize data, analytics and AI. Databricks is headquartered in San Francisco, with offices around the globe and was founded by the original creators of Lakehouse, Apache Spark™, Delta Lake and MLflow. To learn more, follow Databricks on Twitter , LinkedIn and Facebook . Benefits At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region, please visit https://www.mybenefitsnow.com/databricks . Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
